prompt: Turn ONLY this approved design sheet into a production transparent 4-column x 2-row atlas of EIGHT stationary spacecraft HULL sprites. Remove every label, text, background, grid, border, shadow, UI and shield outline. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Eight complete ships, separated into equal regular cells with at least 10% transparent safe margin per cell; no crossing cell boundaries, no clipping; wide 2:1 overall atlas. Do not include the ordinary row or any additional objects.
